svg.title: A plain TLS scan of an upgrade port is silent, not negative
svg.text: Silent is not negative. The port speaks its own protocol first.
the same as a port with no cryptography
in 91 s: every handshake repeats the upgrade
so: name each listener's protocol in the scope (postgres, smtp, imap, ldap), bind it to a profile that speaks the upgrade,
let the plain profile refuse it, and show a protocol no profile claims as unscanned, never as clean
